notes.title: Battlewake Patch v1.0.1 Now Live!
notes.content:
Avast, all ye PC pirates! We just unleashed [i]Battlewake[/i] patch v1.0.1 for Steam and Oculus players, which includes fixes for PvP, weapons, and more. Here are the full patch notes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35024634/a34ed8dd09d2b2d8ac16027de53af8ba848acb1d.gif[/img]

[u][b]Patch Notes for [i]Battlewake[/i] v1.0.1 (released October 22, 2019)[/b][/u][list]
[*] Various crash and stability improvements
[*] [i]Calibration:[/i] Fixed an issue where player would be calibrated incorrectly when using some HMD types
[*] [i]Weapons:[/i] Fixed an issue that caused weapon spread/accuracy to be incorrect on nearby enemies
[*] [i]Voice Chat:[/i] Fixed an issue where Voice Chat Mute button would not function correctly
[*] [i]Plunder PvP:[/i] Resolved an issue that displayed incorrect Health for users before they are damaged
[*] [i]Plunder PvP:[/i] Fixed an issue that caused late-joining players to lose weapon functionality
[/list]
Thank ye all for yer patience, and please keep sending us whatever foul bugs you encounter on your voyages to [url=mailto:support@survios.com]support@survios.com[/url]!

[i]Plunder PvP:[/i] Resolved an issue that displayed incorrect Health for users before they are damaged
[i]Plunder PvP:[/i] Fixed an issue that caused late-joining players to lose weapon functionality

notes.title: The Seas are Yours: Battlewake Now Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35024634/f2986f66b06117ed8f6565240ecb3b5e6cdf5a01.png[/img]

After months of anticipation, including a bombastic PC beta, Survios's new VR game [i]Battlewake[/i] is available now for $29.99, with an additional 15% launch discount! Watch the official launch trailer:
https://youtu.be/8Evthrfr91s
The Seas of New Urth constantly churn with the raging surge of battle. The treacherous Queen’s Company has taken your lands, your freedom, your riches, your power. Once squabbling towards extinction, the Pirate Lords now join forces to destroy their common foe, bound in blood by the demon Andromalius. They must regain their seas, avenge their families, take back their riches, and restore their world, with the fate of New Urth hanging in the balance. But will greed prevail?

Set your course for September 19, for not only is it a very important holiday for all pirates around the world, but it’s also the start of a thrilling community event that we can’t wait to share! Get your plunderin’ parties assembled over at [url=discord.gg/survios]the official Survios Discord[/url], and we’ll see you all upon the high seas…

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/KyGI9aJVFDxkXrNATF/giphy.gif[/img]

[u][b]Known Day 1 Issues[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] [i]Multiplayer[/i] - Players default to Diego when choosing a Pirate Lord after already playing multiplayer once
[*] [i]Multiplayer[/i] - Player will sometimes load into a Lobby or Match for a second time
[*] [i]Multiplayer[/i] - Enemy vessels will jump forward, desyncing position
[*] [i]VFX[/i] - Players cannot see ability projections when preparing special abilities
[*] [i]VFX[/i] - Zhang's and boss ships’ mortar VFX fire is observed floating midair away from the ship
[*] [i]UI[/i] - Some boss ships have two Destroy objective markers above them
[*] [i]Plunder[/i] - Upon respawning, the Helm can be observed falling from the sky
[*] [i]Plunder[/i] - The Flamethrower on Rev Ship's can damage itself
[*] [i]Warfare [Multiplayer][/i] - Sometimes, friendly ships appear to jitter during a Warfare match
[*] [i]Campaign[/i] - Client loses skull scores after closing the application
[*] [i]Campaign[/i] - Earning 1 skull does not display on the rack-up screen
[*] [i]Campaign [Multiplayer][/i] - The client will not unlock the trophy for clearing a Captain's campaign missions
[*] [i]Environment[/i] - Players are not taking damage from volcano meteors
[/list]
